name: Warden's Reckoning
author: NeoMud Team
description: A world where ancient seals are weakening and the line between guardian and destroyer must be chosen.
introScript:
A thousand years ago, the world cracked.

The Wardens sealed what crawled out, and paid for it with their bloodline.

The seals are weakening. The world has forgotten why they matter.

You are the last who can choose what the silence remembers.
